description: Accessing an attribute of an unknown map gives an unknown of the element type
notes: The spec defines attribute access for values of object type only, and gives an unknown result only for an unknown value whose type has the attribute. hashicorp/hcl also accepts attribute access on a map (native/traversals/getattr-on-map-element), and for an unknown map returns an unknown value of the element type (GetAttr in ops.go).
